title: Synthetic order lookup
objective: Fixture example: keep the missing-order response stable.
acceptance: Given an absent fixture order ID, return the documented not-found response.

sections.context-and-scope: Synthetic fixture: only the lookup boundary is in scope.
sections.non-goals: Do not introduce payment or shipping behavior.
sections.the-design: Use the existing fixture lookup adapter.
sections.alternatives-considered: A separate service would add unnecessary state to this fixture.
